tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Find up to five recent public games for a confirmed Chess.com or Lichess username. Use for review-my-game onboarding or a saved chess account. Returns newest-first choices and game links for review_game; it does not review games, save a username or establish that either player is the user.

tools.name: review_game
tools.description: Use when the user asks to review or analyse a chess game, including a pasted Chess.com link. Accepts a Chess.com/Lichess game URL or PGN. tools.name: open_mode
tools.description: Open the original RV Chess play view for Drawfish or another named bot/rule mode. With no name, open the mode directory. Returns the existing mode catalog; do not invent modes or claim a game has started before the user starts it.

tools.name: open_opening

tools.name: analyze_position

tools.name: review_move
tools.description: Open the selected played move on the RV Chess board. RV Chess runs its existing same-root verifier and returns its assessment and board-proven explanation to chat. Input full PGN plus 1-based half-move index from the board context.
